slash.description: Delete the data Mewvo stores for this server (server owner only)

delete.description: See what Mewvo stores for this server and ask for it to be deleted (owner only)

refuse.home: Mewvo's own servers cannot be deleted this way.
refuse.notOwner: Only the owner of this server can ask for its data to be deleted.
refuse.unknown: Discord did not confirm who owns this server right now, so nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
refuse.database: The database is not responding, so nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
refuse.notYours: Only the server owner who opened this can use these buttons.

preview.title: Delete this server's data?
preview.intro: Mewvo stores this for the server (number of records):
preview.empty: Mewvo stores nothing for this server right now.
preview.record: Members' "My record" on the website lists cases from every server: this server's cases disappear from there too.
preview.active: Bans and mutes that are still active are not lifted in Discord, and temporary ones no longer end on their own. Lift them first if needed.
preview.untouched: Not deleted: members' own Mewvo accounts and logins, their data in other servers, and other servers' cases.
preview.grace: The deletion runs {days} days after you confirm. Until then you can cancel it here or on the dashboard.

kind.cases: Moderation cases (notes, evidence, edit history, warn ladder)
kind.moderation: Watchlist, no-contact orders, temporary roles, staff records, modmail links
kind.levels: Levels, birthdays, AFK and member records
kind.automod: Automod rules, raid incidents and timelines
kind.community: Tags, suggestions, starboard, giveaways, scheduled messages, role rules, feeds
kind.oauthLinks: Member backup links (who verified here with Discord)
kind.misc: Error reports, and reminders set here (they keep going by DM)

scheduled.title: Deletion scheduled
scheduled.body: This server's data will be deleted on <t:{unix}:F> (<t:{unix}:R>).
scheduled.leave: Mewvo will then leave the server.
scheduled.hint: Changed your mind? Press Cancel deletion, or run /serverdata delete again.
scheduled.already: A deletion is already scheduled for this server.
scheduled.running: The deletion is running now and can no longer be cancelled.

cancelled: The deletion was cancelled. Nothing was deleted.
notScheduled: There is no scheduled deletion for this server any more.

dm.done: Mewvo deleted the data it stored for the server {server}, as you asked. Members' own accounts and their data in other servers were not touched.
